meta.name: English
app.title: Vancouver Seat Viewer
app.tagline: See the view from your seat before you book.
app.disclaimer: Unofficial fan project — not affiliated with Cineplex Entertainment.
home.heading: Pick a theatre
home.intro: Choose a theatre, an auditorium and a seat. Then walk in, sit down and see how the screen looks from there.
home.empty: No theatres yet. Add one under data/theatres.
theatre.heading: Pick an auditorium
theatre.intro: Match the seat map to the one you saw when booking.
badge.estimatedHint: Screen size and distances are typical values, not measured in this auditorium.
badge.sampleHint: A made-up layout for trying the app. Not a real seat map.
error.notFoundBody: That page doesn't exist, or the link is out of date.
error.seat: We couldn't find that seat in this auditorium.
error.dataTitle: Some data files couldn't be loaded
error.dataBody: They were skipped. Fix the problems below and reload.
verdict.recommended: Comfortable on the neck, and you see the whole screen
verdict.ok: Comfortable, but the screen feels a little small
verdict.tooClose: Turn your head to see it all
verdict.neck: You'll be looking up the whole time
verdict.sideMild: Good size, but you see it from the side
seat.name: Row {row}, Seat {seat}
view.stageLabel: 3D view from {seat}. Drag or use the arrow keys to look around.
view.noWebgl: Your browser couldn't start the 3D view. Try another browser, or turn on hardware acceleration.
seats.title: Pick a seat and sit down
seats.hint: Use the arrow keys to move between seats. Press Enter on the chosen seat to sit down.
legend.avoid: too close, too steep or too far to the side
view.miniMap: Your seat on the seat map
video.openHint: The trailer can't play on the screen here. Open it on YouTube.
trailer.title: Pick a trailer
trailer.intro: It plays on the big screen once you're in your seat.
trailer.pasteHelp: Links with watch?v=, youtu.be/, /shorts/ or /embed/ all work.
trailer.empty: No trailers are listed right now. Paste a YouTube link to watch one on the big screen.
trailer.error.notYouTube: That doesn't look like a YouTube link. Try one from youtube.com or youtu.be.
trailer.error.noVideo: That link doesn't point to a single video. Open the video itself and copy its link.
editor.title: Auditorium editor
editor.intro: Type a seat map, adjust the dimensions and download the auditorium file for the data folder. Nothing is uploaded.
editor.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example riverport-07.
editor.name: Name
editor.seatsHelp: One row per line, from the screen to the back. 1-4 means seats 1 to 4, | is an aisle and _ a single missing seat. Rows with the same number of blocks are lined up so their aisles run straight.
editor.verified: These dimensions were measured on a visit
editor.error.empty: Type at least one row of seats.
editor.error.missingColon: Line {line}: put a colon after the row label, like "A: 1-10".
editor.error.badLabel: Line {line}: "{label}" can't be a row label. Use 1 to 3 letters or digits.
editor.error.badToken: Line {line}: can't read "{token}". Use seat numbers, ranges like 1-10, | or _.
editor.error.duplicateSeat: Line {line}: seat {seat} appears twice in row {label}.
editor.error.tooManySeats: Line {line}: row {label} has more than 80 seats.
editor.alignAisles: Line the aisles up from row to row
